en_us.cannery.crucible.0: The crucible is used to smelt ores, ingots or other metallic items for alloying and to cast them into different shapes.
en_us.cannery.crucible.1: It requires an external heat source connected to the bottom, like a firebox.
en_us.cannery.crucible.2: Once heated up, the crucible can be used in two ways, with or without a recipe template.
en_us.cannery.crucible.3: The crucible has two storage buffers for material:
en_us.cannery.crucible.4: The buffer to the left is for §abyproducts§r, all material smelted without a recipe template will land here.
en_us.cannery.crucible.5: If a recipe is installed, materials that do not match the recipe will also be stored here.
en_us.cannery.crucible.6: Materials in this buffer will not react with each other, they can only be output from the green outlet for casting.
en_us.cannery.crucible.7: The buffer to the right is for §crecipes§r, if a recipe is installed and that particular material is relevant to that recipe, it will land here.
en_us.cannery.crucible.8: The materials will slowly combine into the output material which is automatically output from the red outlet.
en_us.cannery.crucible.9: Note that only this buffer handles recipes. If a template is installed retroactively, materials in the byproduct buffer will not combine, nor transfer to the recipe buffer.
en_us.cannery.crucible.10: The outlet will output material automatically, if the target is valid, for example a foundry channel or a mold.
en_us.cannery.crucible.11: As with all foundry blocks, a shovel can be used to remove all material from the crucible.

zh_cn.cannery.crucible.0: 坩埚用于熔炼矿石、铸锭或其他金属物品以进行合金化，并将其铸造成不同形状。
zh_cn.cannery.crucible.1: 它需要一个外部热源连接到底部，例如燃烧室。
zh_cn.cannery.crucible.2: 一旦加热，坩埚可以以两种方式运行，有或没有配方模板。
zh_cn.cannery.crucible.3: 坩埚有两个材料储存缓冲区：
zh_cn.cannery.crucible.4: 左边的缓冲区用于缓存§a副产品§r，所有没有配方模板的熔炼材料都将缓存在这里。
zh_cn.cannery.crucible.5: 如果有熔炼配方，与配方不匹配的材料也将存储在这里。
zh_cn.cannery.crucible.6: 该缓冲区中的材料不会相互反应，只能从绿色出口输出用于铸造。
zh_cn.cannery.crucible.7: 右侧的缓冲区用于放入§c配方§r，如果安装了一个配方，并且该特定材料与该配方相关，则它将储存在此处。
zh_cn.cannery.crucible.8: 这些材料将慢慢结合成输出材料，从红色出口自动输出。
zh_cn.cannery.crucible.9: 请注意，只有这个缓冲区处理配方。如果更换模板，副产品缓冲区中的材料不会结合，也不会转移到配方缓冲区。
zh_cn.cannery.crucible.10: 如果目标有效，例如铸造通道或模具，出口将自动输出材料。
zh_cn.cannery.crucible.11: 与所有铸造块一样，可以使用铲子从坩埚中移除所有材料。
